title: tunnel_auth decapsulate: expired longest-prefix entry shadows live shorter-prefix grant on same route
description: Found in security review of the tunnel-auth wiring (worker4). tunnel_auth.c:433-438: the entries scan picks best = longest prefix_len among entries matching route_hash AND prefix_match(source). If best is expired, decapsulate evicts it and denies EXPIRED (tunnel_auth.c:438) without falling through to a shorter-prefix, unexpired entry for the same route_hash. Scenario: root issues /64 grant then a /48 grant over the same route; the /64 lapses first; traffic authorized by the live /48 is denied until the /48 itself expires (the evicted slot can only be refilled by a new grant POST). False denial of authorized traffic = availability defect, fail-closed. Fix shape: on expired-best, evict and continue the scan for the next-best unexpired match instead of denying outright.
